bot.intro: Choose how the assistant takes part in conversations on each connected account.
bot.empty: Connect a messenger account first; then you can switch the assistant on here.
bot.readOnly: Only an owner or admin can change this.
botModeDesc.OFF: The assistant does not reply. The system still sends each customer's own message back to them (echo test), so do not use Off on a real customer account.
botModeDesc.SHADOW: The assistant prepares replies internally for checking. Customers receive nothing from it.
botModeDesc.LIVE: The assistant answers customers and hands over to an operator when needed.
botEffective.SHADOW: Right now this account only prepares drafts: customers receive nothing from the assistant.
botEffective.HOLD: Right now customers get no reply from the assistant: it makes no model call and sends nothing, whatever is selected above.

botRefusal.NO_OPERATOR_NOTIFIER: First connect an operator group to this bot: hand-overs are posted there. Until then, drafts only.
botRefusal.UNTRUSTED_REAL_DATA: Not available: this is not a test account and the provider is not approved for real customer data.
bot.rule1: Prices, dates and seats come only from your connected data, never from the model's memory.
bot.rule2: It replies in the customer's language and script.
bot.rule3: It hands the conversation to an operator when a customer asks for a person or the topic needs one.

igConnect.title: Connect Instagram
igConnect.step1: In the Meta App Dashboard, open Instagram > API setup with Instagram business login.
igConnect.step2: Click Generate token next to your Instagram professional account and copy it.
igConnect.step3: Paste it below. It is saved encrypted and is never shown again.
igConnect.doneNext: The account is off until you enable it. Enabling subscribes it to direct messages at Meta.
channels.dropPending: Skip messages sent while the bot was off
channels.dropPendingHint: Telegram keeps messages that arrived while no webhook was set. If they are skipped, the assistant does not answer old messages all at once. On by default for the first enable.
channels.fromServer: This bot is configured on the server, so it is managed there.
channels.needSecrets: Connecting from here needs an encryption key on the server. Administrator: set SECRETS_MASTER_KEY (32 random bytes, base64) in the server settings and restart the API.
channels.needUrl: Enabling needs the public https address of this server. Administrator: set PUBLIC_BASE_URL in the server settings and restart the API.
instagram.step1: Switch the Instagram account to a Professional account (Business or Creator).
instagram.step2: Create an app in Meta for Developers and add the Instagram API with Instagram Login.
instagram.step3: Request the permissions instagram_business_basic and instagram_business_manage_messages. Serving accounts you do not own needs Advanced Access (Meta app review).
instagram.step4: Sign in with the Instagram account to get an access token, and subscribe the app's webhook to the messages field.
instagram.step5: You can only answer a person after they write first: within 24 hours, up to 7 days for a human operator's reply. Text is limited to 1000 bytes.
connect.title: Connect Telegram
connect.step1: In Telegram, open @BotFather and send /newbot (or pick your bot and send /token).
connect.step2: Copy the bot token it gives you.
connect.step3: Paste it below. It is saved encrypted and is never shown again.
connect.doneNext: The account is off until you enable it. Enabling registers the webhook with Telegram.
